review_text: Curious about the new design of Dunkin’s drive-thru stores, we decided to line up and order from the menu board. The font was a bit small compared to the photos, so we ended up guessing our coffee based on the pictures, only to receive a literal Iced Americano, and we do not drink Iced Americano. A funny accident. While waiting for our order, we had a nice chat with the staff, who were all friendly and accommodating. After getting our food, we parked nearby to enjoy it. Dunkin never fails to bring a sense of nostalgia, especially with its long-standing place in Filipino culture as a classic pasalubong favorite. We tried to go inside afterward, but the store was full. Maybe we’ll have better luck next time.
